nodes.description: Registry contract holding congress membership and minimal quorum.
Total number of proposals created; incremented in propose().
Mapping of proposal id to Proposal struct, holding targets, values, calldatas and vote tallies.
One-time setter of the members registry address; has no access control.
Member-only creation of a new proposal with targets, values, signatures and calldatas.
Member-only external entry that forwards the caller to _castVote.
Internal vote recording; updates forVotes/againstVotes and voter receipt.
Member-only payable execution of a passed proposal, performs arbitrary low-level calls.
Member-only cancellation of a proposal after a 3 day timelock if quorum not reached.
View returning stored targets, values, signatures and calldatas of a proposal.
View returning the members registry address.
Internal overflow-checked addition helper used for vote counting.
Payable fallback that emits ReceivedEther; contract accepts ether.
Caller-controlled address used for membership checks, proposal proposer and voting.
Miner-influenceable timestamp stored on proposals and used for the cancel timelock.
Arbitrary low-level call with value to a proposal-supplied target and calldata.
Unchecked integer increment of proposalCount (Solidity 0.6 has no built-in overflow check).
Unchecked addition proposal.timestamp + 259200 used with block.timestamp in cancel.
Address stored into the membersRegistry state variable.
Array of target addresses for the proposed calls.
Array of ether values forwarded with each proposed call.
Array of function signature strings to build calldata.
Array of calldata blobs passed to the external calls.
Human readable proposal description, only emitted in event.
Identifier of the proposal operated on by castVote, execute, cancel and getActions.
Vote direction: true for, false against.
Address of the voter whose receipt is written in _castVote.
First addend of add256.
Second addend of add256.
Memory Proposal built in propose() and copied into proposals mapping.
Storage pointer to a Proposal loaded from the proposals mapping.
Storage pointer to the voter's Receipt inside a proposal.
Encoded calldata (signature + args) built in execute's loop.
Boolean result of the low-level call in execute.
Loop counter iterating over proposal actions in execute.
Result of a + b inside add256.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the proposal proposer.
msg.sender is passed into _castVote as the voter.
Voter identity originates from the untrusted caller.
msg.sender is emitted in the ReceivedEther event.
onlyMember uses msg.sender to gate execution via the registry.
onlyMember uses msg.sender to gate cancellation.
castVote forwards execution to _castVote.
User supplied registry address flows into setMembersRegistry.
membersRegistry can be set by any caller the first time, bootstrapping trust.
propose increments proposalCount without overflow protection.
propose writes the new proposal into the proposals mapping.
block.timestamp is stored as the proposal creation time.
cancel depends on block.timestamp to enforce the timelock.
block.timestamp is compared against the unchecked timestamp sum.
Unchecked timestamp addition feeds the cancel timelock check.
execute performs an arbitrary low-level call with value.
The external call can re-enter the payable fallback and other entry points.
proposalId selects which proposal is voted on.
proposalId selects which proposal is executed.
proposalId selects which proposal is canceled.
proposalId selects which proposal actions are read.
support decides whether forVotes or againstVotes is incremented.
voter address indexes the proposal receipts mapping.
First addend flows into add256.
Second addend flows into add256.
_castVote uses add256 to compute vote tallies.
_castVote mutates proposal tallies and receipts in storage.
Targets array stored in the new proposal.
Values array stored in the new proposal.
Signatures array stored in the new proposal.
Calldatas array stored in the new proposal.
Description is emitted with the ProposalCreated event.
Stored targets become the destinations of the low-level calls.
Stored calldatas become the payload of the low-level calls.
In-memory proposal is copied into storage.
Storage pointer aliases the proposals mapping entry.
execute reads targets, values, signatures and calldatas through the pointer.
Voter receipt is read and written to prevent double voting.
Encoded callData is supplied to the low-level call.
success captures whether the low-level call succeeded.
Loop index controls how many external calls are made.
c holds the a + b result returned by add256.

normalization_plan.reason: The only parameter is consumed solely by setMembersRegistry before being written to state.
Targets are validated and stored inside propose before later being read by execute.
Values are arity-checked and stored inside propose.
Signatures are arity-checked and stored inside propose.
Calldatas are arity-checked and stored inside propose.
Description is only emitted by propose and never stored.
Proposal id is the shared index used by every proposal operation, most critically the execute loop.
Support is only used to choose the vote tally branch inside _castVote.
Voter is only used as the receipt mapping key inside _castVote.
First addend exists only for the add256 arithmetic helper.
Second addend exists only for the add256 arithmetic helper.
Temporary memory struct that is immediately persisted by propose.
Storage pointer that aliases the proposals mapping entry consumed by execute.
Storage pointer used only to guard and record a ballot in _castVote.
callData is constructed exclusively to feed the low-level external call.
success is the returned status of the low-level external call.
Loop counter drives the repeated external calls in execute.
c is the temporary overflow-checked sum returned by add256.
